top.title: GPT-6.1 Terra reportedly beats Claude Opus 5.5 on cost and speed
top.summary: A comparison of GPT-6.1 Terra and Claude Opus 5.5 reports that GPT-6.1 was cheaper and faster across three tests at maximum effort; the excerpt provides no specific measurements.
